Trailing trim plus downstream trimEnd mean rows are written short and surplus columns survive; two-part fix pads full width and appends ESC[K while stopping pipeline trimming; RESET erases nothing; erase survives trimming.

tail2 hand-copied with 23 differing cells (1-col shift plus extra D/DD), visible cluster smaller than diff count; data drift vs renderer artifact separated; excerpt regression for a different frame missed it; full-frame sha256 manifest against source art in CI proposed.

CI hosts mount without unmount while the planner re-arms ref'd timeouts, pinning the event loop; interactive TTY/stdin masks it; unref on each re-armed timer, with clearTimeout as complement only; rejects timeout-extension fixes implicitly by fixing lifecycle.

Checklist covers complete per-cell SGR state, full-width/no-trim, digest-pinned frames, handle lifecycle; pre-flip audit inventories timers across every mounting host including never-unmounting probes, with per-profile exit smoke and duration guard; static work suffices.
